mapper.select: select ci.v_career_id , ci.v_career_nm , to_char(ci.d_start_dtm, 'YYYY-MM') as d_start_dtm , to_char(ci.d_end_dtm, 'YYYY-MM') as d_end_dtm , (EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(d_end_dtm, d_start_dtm)) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(d_end_dtm, d_start_dtm))) AS total_months from career_info ci where v_flag_del = 'N' order by ci.d_start_dtm

select cd.v_detail_id , cd.v_detail_nm , cd.v_career_id , (select string_agg(cdd.v_cont, '|' order by cdd.n_sort) from career_detail_desc cdd where cdd.v_flag_del = 'N' and cdd.v_detail_id = cd.v_detail_id) as v_cont from career_detail cd where v_flag_del = 'N' order by cd.v_career_id desc, cd.n_sort
